result.brief: CoVA 通过轻量 latent composer 在线组合 VAE 特征，为流匹配训练提供语义判别、空间结构化的密集表征与样本相关类别后验，并揭示软标签条件中的幅度衰减混淆。
result.reason: Composes VAE features into semantically structured dense representations for generative training, directly addressing RAE/generative latent space and representation alignment interests.
